entities.name: Otto Rühle
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karl Heinrich Otto Rühle was a German Marxist writer, educator, Reichstag deputy, and prominent theorist of the council-communist movement. He is known for his rejection of party politics in favour of workers' councils, his critique of Bolshevism, and his famous declaration: "The revolution is not a party affair".
